name: grafta-video
description: The home page's demo video, as a Remotion composition.

scripts.studio: npm run prepare-assets && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run prepare-assets && npm run vtt && npm run render:web && npm run render:social && npm run render:gif
scripts.render:web: remotion render src/index.ts Web out/demo.mp4 --crf 24 --port 3191 && ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i out/demo.mp4 -c:v libvpx-vp9 -b:v 0 -crf 36 -row-mt 1 -an out/demo.webm && ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i out/demo.mp4 -frames:v 1 -vf scale=1600:-1 -q:v 4 out/poster.jpg && cp out/demo.mp4 out/demo.webm out/poster.jpg ../web/public/showcase/video/
